verdict.rationale: Figma documents a REST API and Plugin API that expose file objects, layers, and properties for external tooling (figma-docs-7, figma-docs-26, figma-docs-32), suggesting some level of documented access outside the editor. However, this is not an open file format spec, and hands-on community feedback explicitly contradicts the portability claim: 'you don't get to keep a local file... your full fidelity work is locked up in a proprietary format' (figma-comm-7). Missing for 10: an actual open/published file-format specification (not just API endpoints), and evidence that full-fidelity design data can be losslessly exported/round-tripped outside Figma's own editor.
